title: A shape's bar never vanishes from its track, and an empty track can take one back
goal: User 2026-09-26: 'I made a rectangle. It was in the timeline. I did something which caused it to be removed (the box in the timeline disappeared) but the track was still there. 1. why did it ever disappear, and 2. if a rectangle layer has no content in its track, I don't know what to do with the track other than delete it. There is no way to bring it back and size it in the timeline.' The user does not know which action did it. A layer is on the timeline only while it occupiesTime or hasMotion (DocumentTracks.swift isOnTheTimeline), and tracks are written down separately, so an empty track can outlive its bar. Find every action that removes a graphic's bar while leaving its track (and say whether the rectangle itself survived on the canvas in each): e.g. dragging a bar's edge past its other edge to zero length (see dragging-a-bar-s-end-tracks-the-pointer-without), Delete or ripple delete with the bar selected, the Delete key's piece dropping (3e5d6ddc), a trim that clamps to nothing, cut or split leaving no piece, undo across the 'gets its own row' step, grouping, moving to another track.
acceptance: Every such action is reproduced with a walk at Next defaults and listed in the task log with what happened to the layer and the track
A bar can never be trimmed or dragged below one frame; zero length is impossible, so a bar never silently disappears
Deleting a graphic's bar deletes the layer from the canvas too (one undo step, as Premiere's Delete does), and a track left empty by it shows as empty, never as a mystery

An empty track reads as empty and is useful: drop or drag any layer from the layers list or the canvas onto it; right-click the empty track: Add Rectangle / Text / Paste Here at the playhead; and a layer that is on the canvas but on no track can be put back by right-click Put on Timeline (from the canvas or layers list), landing from the playhead for 5 s
Right-click an empty track: Delete Track, Delete Empty Tracks; empty tracks are never created by the app itself
Undo restores the bar exactly after any of the actions above
Walk photographs: rectangle's bar, the action that used to lose it (now kept or cleanly deleted with the layer), an empty track receiving a layer by drag and by right-click

log.note: Reproduced in core (EmptyTracksTests, rectangle over an 8s take with tracks written down). Layer GONE + track left EMPTY: Delete/⌫ on the bar (timeline ⌫ = lift -> deleteSelectedLayers), ripple delete, Extract or Lift over its whole stretch. Layer KEPT + its Rectangle track left EMPTY: grouping it (group got a new V2 row), carrying it to a new track (moveClipToNewTrack). Layer KEPT, bar looks GONE: dragging one end past the other left a 10ms bar (~1px). Deleting the recording left V1 empty. Split everything / ripple deleting a recording piece: bar kept. Most likely user path: grouping (rectangle still in the layers list, its row empty) or ⌫ with the bar picked.

Fixed: LayerTime.shortestMS is one frame (33ms, MovieRef.frameStepMS) so no trim goes below a frame; a one-piece bar draws at least 6pt. EditorState.perform runs dropTracksEmptied(since:) inside every edit's own step: a track the app made for a shape/title/group (id == that layer's id, not media) goes when the edit empties it; V1/Audio and tracks the person added stay. New EmptyTracks.swift: emptyTrackIDs, deleteEmptyTracks, putOnTimeline(id, atMS, onTrack) (5s from the playhead, last 5s near the end), landNewLayers. Track right-click on an empty picture track: Add Rectangle, Add Text, Paste Here, Put Layer Here > (off-timeline layers); every track menu: Delete Empty Tracks. Layer row + canvas menus: Put on Timeline when a layer is on no track.

Decided: no drag from the layers list onto a track, because in Next the open timeline IS the layers list (TimelineIsTheLayerList), so the two never share the screen; a bar carried onto an empty track is the drag. Harness: clipCarryUpATrackHeld now carries a picked shape's bar too. Walk a-shape-s-bar-keeps-its-track-walk: 81 steps ok, 10 real captures (Delete takes row, undo restores, group leaves no empty rows, carry onto empty track, Add Text on empty track, Delete Empty Tracks). Neighbour walks (tracks, drawn shape row, library clip, track select, opacity, turned shape, captions track) 8/8 ok. Scripts/test.sh 9932 tests green. RippleTrimTests sliver case moved to the one-frame floor.

left rough: Add Text lands a layer named Text running playhead to end of shot (not 5s); Put on Timeline / Put Layer Here only reachable from older docs at defaults, covered by tests not walks; Paste Here not walked (shared clipboard); a 409ms hitch on the first Add Text (font/title look first use) seen once in the walk log. None earned its own task.

Every way a shape's bar left an empty row is fixed: tracks the app made for a shape/title/group go with the edit that empties them (same undo step), bars stop at one frame and draw at least 6pt, an empty track's right-click adds a rectangle/text/paste or puts a stray layer on it, Delete Empty Tracks, and Put on Timeline on layer and canvas menus. Verified by EmptyTracksTests, the new a-shape-s-bar-keeps-its-track-walk (81 steps, 10 real captures), 8 neighbour walks, Scripts/test.sh 9932 green.
